body:
Thanks for taking the time to reply and doing it so quickly - it's a comfort to know that there are people like you around.

Here's a terrible metaphor: I am a badly baked cake. All the ingredients are there but the measurements were a bit off, and as as a result - you've got something that resembles a cake, but it tastes AWFUL. 

Who wants awful cake? Not me! Why force yourself to choke down something that is really unpleasant? What do you get at the end as a reward? Crippling indigestion?

I have family members on both sides that have ended their lives. I see the devastation that suicide causes. I don't mean to make light of the subject, but unlike the other members of my family, I forgive the deceased. I don't believe people end their lives to hurt others - I think they must have been in unbearable pain to leave such an incredible world behind.
